# Why Yammu is spelled that way — and what it costs to get it right

There is a version of this name the early internet had to settle for: *yammu*. This is the file on how **Yammu** replaced it.

Yammu’s mythology is the Baal Cycle’s opening act: the sea demands the storm-god’s surrender, the council wavers, and Baʿal — armed by the craftsman-god Kothar-wa-Khasis with two magic clubs — goes out to meet the flood and splits the sea’s skull between the eyes. It is the Levant’s own dragon-combat — the same pattern as Marduk and Tiamat, Indra and Vritra, told in the oldest alphabetic literature on earth.

## At a Glance

- **Restored name:** Yammu
- **ASCII form:** yammu
- **Meaning:** "Sea"
- **Domain of influence:** Sea, Chaos
- **Pantheon:** Phoenician
- **Restoration:** ASCII-equivalent form
- **Original script:** 𐤉𐤌
- **Series:** The Restoration Files, No. 584 of 597

## The Name Before the Marks


Spoken, the name runs `/ˈjɑːmʊ/` — “YAH-moo”

## The Temple That Stands Now

The restored name is not a plaque; it is an address. The temple of **Yammu** lives at [/yammu/](/yammu/), with its mythology in the [lore halls](/yammu/lore/), its peer-reviewed record in the [Scholarly Edition](/yammu/scholars/), and its place in the pattern atlas on the [patterns floor](/yammu/patterns/).

aSCII-equivalent form

## Where the Name Stood First

Yammu’s monuments are the tablets: the Baal Cycle’s cuneiform pages from Ras Shamrt (Ugarit), 1929 — the oldest large alphabetic texts ever found, and the foundation-stones of Northwest Semitic philology. The temple on the web is the newest of these addresses — the first one that fits in a pocket.

## The Archetype at Work

The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) seats this temple in **3 industries**, each match argued and weighted: **Maritime, Shipping & Ocean Industries** (the sea itself as god — the Ugaritic ocean whose defeat by Baal is the Levant's oldest sea-story.); **Disaster Resilience & Recovery** (the sea subdued — the chaos-flood as the perennial threat the storm manages.); **Meteorology & Weather Intelligence** (the sea Baal must break — the storm-versus-ocean combat is weather’s oldest dramatization.). The [Resonance File](/yammu/blog/resonance/) reads those seats through the myths themselves.

## The Emblems

The name does not travel alone. **The Sea Itself** — His name IS the word “sea” (ym) — the ocean as the first rebel against order.; **The Two Clubs** — “Chaser” and “Driver”, the magic clubs Baʿal threw to shatter his skull — the cycle’s most quoted scene.; **The Divine Council** — He demanded Baʿal’s surrender from the council of El; the gods’ cowardice set the war in motion.. Each emblem is filed in the temple's record with its own provenance, the same discipline the spelling gets.

## For the Voice

“YAH-moo” The reconstructed line runs `/ˈjɑːmʊ/` — the temple's pronunciation atlas carries the phonemes one by one.

## The Discipline It Answers To

This restoration belongs to Phoenician, a tradition with its own exact discipline. The rules that govern it are not house style; they are the tradition's own scholarship, applied with the same care here as in any edition — and published, with the sources, so the file can be checked the way an edition can be checked. aSCII-equivalent form
